audiences: Kids (6-11); Pre-schoolers (3-5); Toddlers (18 mos. to 3 yrs); Tweens (11-13)
description: Join PACL and Project HumaneKind as we host Rhea Sampson and her rescue dog, Travis (a rat-terrier/chihuahua mix), at the Children's Library! Rhea is the author of the book Saving Travis . This presentation will consist of a reading of her book, a discussion about good pet care, and a sing-a-long! Please arrive on time. Project HumaneKind teaches compassion and respect for living beings. Through humane education, they combat cruelty and indifference and bring awareness to the intelligent, social, and emotional depths of our fellow animals. Visit them online at www.projecthumanekind.org .
